summary.business_type: Hybrid productized-service + content publisher (landing-page conversion audit/fix product, not e-commerce or local)
top_findings: LIVE INCIDENT: site-wide CSS delivery is broken (500/404) - every page renders unstyled right now
The 8aa1434a cache-header fix did not take effect in production - a config rule-ordering bug still serves max-age=0 on all static assets
21 of 26 /learning-centre articles have no server-rendered internal links (JS-accordion-gated, not crawlable)
/pricing and a learning-centre article carry live, contradictory FAQ schema about what customers actually receive
The site's strongest experience claim ('50+ landing pages') exists only in llms.txt, invisible to human visitors
/audit, the core free-tool page, has zero indexable WebApplication schema or example output versus tool-type SERP competitors
sitemap.xml is missing 8 confirmed-live pages, including two (/about, /about/team) with no internal link anywhere
quick_wins: Fix GitHub profile website field (points to aisyndicate.io instead of nebulacomponents.shop)
Remove the deprecated HowTo JSON-LD block from the homepage
Add /terms, /about, /about/team, and 5 missing learning-centre articles to sitemap.xml
Set a real Strict-Transport-Security header (currently max-age=0)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt correctly segments AI-training vs AI-retrieval crawlers
All 33 sitemap URLs self-canonicalize correctly
Clean single-hop protocol/host redirects, no noindex leakage
Full SSR content, no CSR dependency
Entire .well-known/ agent-discovery stack resolves validly

findings.title: Site-wide CSS delivery broken in production
findings.description: Homepage/pricing/audit CSS chunk returns HTTP 500 (text/plain); learning-centre articles reference a different chunk returning 404. Stale ISR-cached HTML pointing at a purged build manifest.
findings.recommendation: Force clean redeploy, revalidate all ISR-cached HTML, add a post-deploy smoke check on all linked stylesheets.

findings.title: Broken self-canonical on /terms and /about/team
findings.description: Both pages emit <link rel="canonical" href="https://nebulacomponents.shop"/> instead of self-referencing, causing Google to consolidate them into the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Fix metadata export to self-canonicalize; add both to sitemap.xml.

findings.title: HSTS actively disabled
findings.description: strict-transport-security: max-age=0 on every response - instructs browsers to drop any cached HSTS policy.
findings.recommendation: Set Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload once confirmed intentional to enforce.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header
findings.description: No CSP found anywhere, notable given Stripe checkout and x402/USDC payment flows on the domain.
findings.recommendation: Add CSP starting Report-Only, tune, then enforce.

findings.title: Trailing-slash duplicate relies solely on canonical
findings.description: /pricing and /pricing/ both return 200 with no redirect between them.
findings.recommendation: Add a normalizing 308 redirect.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Zero content-integrity corruption found across 33 sampled pages
Honest 'no case studies yet, on purpose' framing is a genuine trust asset
9-article well-developed batch has strong AI-citation-ready passage structure
Correct technical vocabulary throughout, no factual/terminology errors found

findings.title: Weighted E-E-A-T ~41/100 (Weak band)
findings.description: Driven by an unsubstantiated-on-page flagship experience claim and a 45-word founder bio with no credentials or methodology.
findings.recommendation: Move the '50+ landing pages' claim onto /about and /about/team with corroborating detail; expand the founder bio.

findings.title: 9 of 25 live articles under 500 words
findings.description: Thin by any informational-content standard; several read as skeletal heading lists (one heading per ~20 words).
findings.recommendation: Expand to genuine depth or consolidate into the relevant pillar article.

findings.title: Content batch bifurcation with a live templating bug
findings.description: Weak batch carries a fallback 2026-01-01 date and one article renders a raw URL slug in its visible category eyebrow.
findings.recommendation: Fix slug-to-label humanization; set real per-page publish/modified dates.

findings.title: Bounded cannibalization risk in the trust/CTA sub-theme
findings.description: cta-not-working, proof-before-cta, message-match-checklist, and no-testimonials-on-landing-page converge on the same core argument with thin differentiation.
findings.recommendation: Deepen differentiation or merge the thinnest into the strongest with a redirect.

findings.title: 3 articles topically off-hub, one disclosed as sourced from a different product
findings.description: founder-second-brain, linkedin-skill-engine, specialist-ai-agent-library are unrelated to landing-page conversion; one explicitly says 'extracted from NipPro AI'.
findings.recommendation: Relocate to a separate content vertical or prune from /learning-centre.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Clean heading hierarchy and URL structure across sampled pages
A real, organically-emerged pillar page exists with strong inbound link concentration

findings.title: 21 of 26 learning-centre articles have no server-rendered internal links
findings.description: Article list lives only in a client-side JSON hydration payload behind an accordion toggle; Googlebot does not simulate clicks.
findings.recommendation: Server-render the full article list; add a flat 'browse all guides' fallback.

findings.title: Pillar page link equity flows up, not down
findings.description: landing-page-not-converting receives links from nearly every spoke but links back to only 5 of ~25.
findings.recommendation: Add a 'diagnose your leak' dispatcher section linking to a representative article per cluster.

findings.title: Confirmed cannibalization pair
findings.description: landing-page-not-converting and ecommerce-landing-page-not-converting share 4 of ~7 top SERP results.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate with ecommerce-specific evidence or consolidate with a redirect.

findings.title: No dedicated title/meta-description audit performed this round
findings.description: This category score is a blended estimate from internal-linking and heading-structure signals only.
findings.recommendation: Run a follow-up /seo page pass per key template.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Well-built @id-linked Organization/founder/WebSite graph reused correctly across pages
Genuinely complete Service+Offer+OfferCatalog schema on /pricing
Working Article schema across the learning-centre template
Correctly no fake Review/AggregateRating on /case-studies

findings.title: Deprecated HowTo schema live on homepage
findings.description: Google removed HowTo rich results in Sept 2023; block has produced zero SERP benefit for ~3 years.
findings.recommendation: Remove outright, do not replace with FAQPage.

findings.title: Article schema missing image property
findings.description: Blocks Top Stories/article rich-result eligibility on every article checked.
findings.recommendation: Add absolute image URL to the Article template.

findings.title: Author entity fragmentation
findings.description: Articles inline the founder as 'Mike H' instead of referencing the canonical #founder @id used sitewide ('Mike Holownych').
findings.recommendation: Replace inline Person with an @id reference.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList anywhere on the site
findings.description: An active, non-deprecated rich result left entirely unused despite real hierarchical paths.
findings.recommendation: Add to the article template, /resources/citable, and /about/team.

findings.title: FAQPage on /pricing has no remaining Google SERP benefit
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites May 7, 2026. Valid and harmless; do not remove, do not add elsewhere.
findings.recommendation: No action required.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: TTFB excellent everywhere (18-49ms)
DOM size healthy on all pages tested
Third-party script loading and font preload strategy already correct

findings.title: Cache-header fix did not take effect in production
findings.description: next.config.ts's older catch-all rule still wins over the new immutable-cache rule for /_next/static/ assets, confirmed at both Cloudflare edge and Next.js origin directly.
findings.recommendation: Reorder or scope the catch-all rule; re-verify with curl -sI before considering fixed.

findings.title: LCP fails 'Good' on all 8 page/device combinations tested
findings.description: Mobile LCP 3.56-4.28s (3 of 4 in Poor band >4.0s); desktop 3.5-3.8s everywhere.
findings.recommendation: Identify and prioritize the actual LCP element per template with fetchPriority/preload.

findings.title: Mobile interactivity risk poor
findings.description: TBT (INP proxy) 538-894ms on mobile across all pages; ~500KB unused JS shipped on every page regardless of route.
findings.recommendation: Bundle-analyze the shared chunk and code-split route-specific logic out of it.

findings.title: Homepage-only CLS issue
findings.description: 0.171 mobile / 0.118 desktop, both above the 0.1 Good threshold; other 3 pages measured near-zero.
findings.recommendation: Trace the shifting element via DevTools Performance panel.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt correctly separates AI-training crawlers (disallowed) from AI-answer-engine crawlers (allowed)
Spec-compliant, well-organized llms.txt/llms-full.txt
Mostly-functional .well-known/ agent-discovery stack with genuinely working x402 payments
Strong direct-answer/question-heading citability patterns in well-developed articles

findings.title: Advertised A2A and MCP endpoints both 404
findings.description: agent.json and mcp/server-card.json advertise /a2a and /mcp; both return 404 on every method, unlike the working x402 endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Implement minimal handlers or remove the discovery documents until real endpoints exist.

findings.title: '50+ landing pages' claim exists only in AI-facing files
findings.description: Not present on /about, /about/team, or any human-visible page or JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: Add the same claim to the visible founder bio.

findings.title: /about and /about/team absent from sitemap.xml
findings.description: The pages carrying the strongest entity/authority signals on the site are unindexed via sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Add both to sitemap.ts.

findings.title: Multi-modal content effectively zero
findings.description: No images, video, or YouTube presence found anywhere; YouTube is the strongest brand-mention correlate with AI citation.
findings.recommendation: Publish one founder-narrated video walkthrough.

findings.title: Zero content images sitewide
findings.description: No tags found on homepage, /audit, /pricing, or any sampled learning-centre article - only small inline UI-icon SVGs, despite the product being a visual landing-page diagnosis service.
findings.recommendation: Add annotated before/after screenshots per article and a sample /audit report output image.
